info.name: ICT LMS API
info.description:
# ICT Learning Management System API

Comprehensive API documentation for the ICT Learning Management System.

## Authentication

This API uses session-based authentication. After logging in via `/api/method/login`,
Frappe sets a session cookie (`sid`) which is automatically included in subsequent requests.

### Login Example
```bash
curl -X POST https://yourdomain.com/api/method/login \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"usr": "user@example.com", "pwd": "password"}'
```

### Guest Access

Endpoints marked with `allow_guest=True` can be accessed without authentication.
No cookie or header is required.

## Base URL

All endpoints use the base URL: `/api/method/`

## Rate Limiting

Some endpoints implement rate limiting (500 requests per hour per user).


Contact Support:
 Name: ICT LMS Support
 Email: support@example.com

request.description:
Authenticate a user and start a session.  
Frappe sets a session cookie (`sid`) in the response headers.

Mobile apps should store the `sid` cookie and send it on every request:  
`Cookie: sid=`.

End the current session.
Clears the `sid` session cookie.

request.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of courses with optional filters.

Supports filtering by:
- `title` - Search by course title
- `enrolled` - Filter by enrollment status
- `published` - Filter published courses only
- `certification` - Courses with certification

**Rate Limit:** 500 requests per hour
